title: Get started with inmetr
text: municipalities station . inmet_nearest() ranks stations distance municipality seat. accepts IBGE code name, accents case don’t matter. name shared several municipalities error. Pass state choose one: inmet_stations() returns full station table. Closed stations stay status = "closed", first_obs last_obs show period station covers.
code: poa <- inmet_nearest("Porto Alegre", n = 3) poa |>   select(code_station, name_station, status, name_muni, distance_km) #> # A tibble: 3 × 5 #>   code_station name_station                   status    name_muni    distance_km #>   <chr>        <chr>                          <chr>     <chr>              <dbl> #> 1 A801         Porto Alegre - Jardim Botanico operating Porto Alegre        5.91 #> 2 B807         Porto Alegre- Belem Novo       operating Porto Alegre       18.2  #> 3 A884         Campo Bom                      operating Campo Bom          42.4 inmet_nearest("Bom Jesus") #> Error in `inmet_nearest()`: #> ! Ambiguous `muni` "Bom Jesus". Matches: Bom Jesus/PI (2201903), Bom #>   Jesus/RN (2401701), Bom Jesus/PB (2502201), Bom Jesus/SC (4202537), Bom #>   Jesus/RS (4302303), Bom Jesus/GO (5203500). Use `state` or an IBGE code. inmet_nearest("Bom Jesus", state = "RS") |>   select(code_station, name_station, distance_km) #> # A tibble: 1 × 3 #>   code_station name_station          distance_km #>   <chr>        <chr>                       <dbl> #> 1 A829         Sao Jose Dos Ausentes        37.9 inmet_stations() |>   count(status) #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   status        n #>   <chr>     <int> #> 1 broken       97 #> 2 closed       50 #> 3 operating   469

title: Get started with inmetr
text: read_inmet() returns lazy table. years argument controls files downloaded, dplyr verbs build SQL query DuckDB runs call collect(). inmetr publishes INMET’s values without outlier filtering coverage thresholds, choose coverage rule suits analysis. query keeps days mean temperature least 18 hours data, n_days reports many days month retains. n_hours counts hours least one valid measurement variable, doesn’t guarantee 18 hours temperature readings. variable-specific coverage, count non-missing values hourly table. daily table aggregates hourly one local standard date. sub-daily questions, use read_inmet("hourly", years = ...) way. Timestamps UTC, date_local hour_local give station’s local standard time.
code: daily <- read_inmet("daily", years = 2020:2024)  monthly <- daily |>   filter(code_station == "A801", !is.na(temp_mean_c), n_hours >= 18) |>   group_by(year, month) |>   summarise(     temp_mean_c = mean(temp_mean_c),     n_days = n(),     .groups = "drop"   ) |>   arrange(year, month) |>   collect() #> Warning: Missing values are always removed in SQL aggregation functions. #> Use `na.rm = TRUE` to silence this warning #> This warning is displayed once every 8 hours.  monthly #> # A tibble: 60 × 4 #>     year month temp_mean_c n_days #>    <int> <int>       <dbl>  <dbl> #>  1  2020     1        25.3     31 #>  2  2020     2        24.8     29 #>  3  2020     3        24.5     31 #>  4  2020     4        20.4     30 #>  5  2020     5        16.8     31 #>  6  2020     6        16.5     30 #>  7  2020     7        13.7     31 #>  8  2020     8        16.1     31 #>  9  2020     9        16.9     30 #> 10  2020    10        19.3     31 #> # ℹ 50 more rows

title: Find stations nearest a municipality seat — inmet_nearest
text: muni One seven-digit IBGE municipality codes municipality names. n Maximum number stations return per municipality. max_km Optional maximum distance kilometres. state Optional two-letter state abbreviation name matching. Either one value every muni one value per muni; use NA skip element. status Optional station statuses keep: "operating", "broken" "closed". See inmet_stations() meaning. NULL keeps every station.

title: Read INMET station metadata — inmet_stations
text: status records station's state INMET station catalog used build release: "operating": listed operating (Operante). "broken": listed faulty (Pane). station may stopped reporting recently may still report gaps, earlier observations kept. Check last_obs coverage variables need dropping . "closed": absent catalog, though historical files hold observations . last_obs gives last observation release.

text: One row per station hour INMET's files, including hours every measurement missing.

title: Read INMET observations lazily — read_inmet
text: pipeline aggregates hourly rows station date_local. Every available hour contributes, aggregate NA hourly inputs missing, daily sum never zero lack data. Three features daily table need care. Empty days. INMET's files list hours measurements, daily table rows n_hours == 0 every measurement NA. Counting rows per station-year therefore counts calendar days, days data. Filter n_hours first. n_hours counts hours measurement. day can n_hours == 24 one variable missing day. Coverage rules single variable need hourly table; example counts hours temp_max_c. Extremes fall back hourly reading. hour, temp_max_c uses hourly maximum present temp_dry_bulb_c otherwise. temp_min_c, rel_humidity_max_pct rel_humidity_min_pct work way. extreme field missing long spells, daily extremes come hourly reading alone.

title: Read INMET observations lazily — read_inmet
code: if (FALSE) { # interactive() daily <- read_inmet("daily", 2024) dplyr::collect(dplyr::filter(daily, .data$code_muni == 3550308L))  # Hours per day with a measured temp_max_c, to drop days that rely on the # dry-bulb fallback read_inmet("hourly", 2021) |>   dplyr::filter(.data$code_station == "A409") |>   dplyr::summarise(     n_hours_temp_max = sum(as.integer(!is.na(.data$temp_max_c)), na.rm = TRUE),     .by = c("code_station", "date_local")   ) |>   dplyr::collect() }

title: inmetr 0.1.0
text: inmet_cache_dir() inmet_cache_clear() manage versioned cache. inmet_nearest() finds stations municipality-seat coordinates. inmet_stations() reads verified station metadata. read_inmet() queries verified hourly daily Parquet data lazily.
